evidence_items.publisher: Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence
evidence_items.explanation: The report records substantial improvement on software issue resolution and also reports gains on multimodal understanding and science questions. These are system-level benchmark comparisons, so they do not isolate changes in model weights from changes in surrounding tools.

The same researchers emphasize that substantial measured progress coexists with poor reliability on ordinary autonomous work. This supports the surrounding concern about limitations, but does not establish an absence of improvement.

unresolved_gaps: There is no agreed threshold for 'meaningful' improvement.
The cited evaluations do not establish dependable performance across all everyday work or all generative modalities.
